gate_results.rationale: At the opportunity phase, the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT shows non-standard technology with no approved waiver (catalog_status "non_standard", waiver_present false; corroborated by authoritative TECH_CATALOG), triggering IT-CATALOG-001 (high, REWORK, action SUBMIT_TECHNOLOGY_WAIVER owned by IT Architecture). It also shows duplicate_capability true with existing alternative "shared_api_platform", which the authoritative CMDB confirms as an existing record, triggering IT-RATIONAL-001 (medium, REWORK, action ASSESS_EXISTING_CAPABILITY owned by Enterprise Architecture). All other IT predicates fail or are phase-gated: license_compliant true; cmdb_record_present true and run_owner_present true (CMDB_EXPORT: record_present "True", run_owner David Santos-12014-SO); technology_eol_months 18 (not <12); capacity_headroom_pct 45 (not <15); change_record_status "draft" only triggers IT-CHANGE-001 at deployment_closure, not opportunity. Highest applicable disposition is REWORK; REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required and no risk acceptance is pursued.

Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE (age 0 days) triggers two predicates. ARCH-DATA-001 (high, REWORK): data_owner_present is false for a Confidential-classified workload, corroborated by the non-authoritative DATA_MODEL showing data_owner null and lineage_complete false. ARCH-REV-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS): reversibility_status is "missing", so the exit architecture must be completed. All other predicates fail to fire: ip_overlap false (no ARCH-IP-001); api_gateway_required true with api_gateway_present true (no ARCH-API-001); measured_latency_ms 15 does not exceed latency_target_ms 500 (no ARCH-PERF-001); business_criticality High but architecture_profile shows multi_az true and multi_region true (no ARCH-HA-001). Highest applicable disposition is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required and no risk acceptance is pursued for ARCH-REV-001 despite it being risk-acceptance-allowed. Proposed actions ASSIGN_DATA_OWNER (Data Architect) and COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE (Enterprise Architect) are remediation to be completed, not completed remediation. Upstream IT gate REWORK (IT-CATALOG-001, IT-RATIONAL-001) remains open but does not alter this gate's disposition.

Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY (age 0 days) triggers three security predicates. SEC-WAF-002 (high, REWORK): internet_exposed true and waf_present true with waf_mode "Detection", so the internet-facing workload is protected only in detection-only mode; action ENABLE_WAF_PREVENTION (Network Security). SEC-LOG-001 (high, REWORK): logs_to_siem false, corroborated by authoritative SENTINEL_STATUS showing sentinel false and an empty connectors list; action CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM (SOC). SEC-KEY-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS): key_rotation_days 365, absent or too infrequent for the target profile; action IMPROVE_KEY_ROTATION (Cloud Security). All other predicates fail to fire: SEC-WAF-001 (waf_present true), SEC-NET-001 (private_endpoints true despite Confidential classification), SEC-IAM-001 (mfa "mandatory"), SEC-IAM-002 (shared_service_principal false), SEC-VULN-001 (critical_vulns_open 0; the 5 open high findings have no predicate), and SEC-PENTEST-001 (phase is design, not build_acceptance, and pentest_status is "pass"). Highest applicable disposition is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required; risk acceptance is not pursued for SEC-WAF-002 or SEC-KEY-001 despite being risk-acceptance-allowed, because remediation is the appropriate path and risk acceptance is a distinct action. Proposed actions are remediation to be completed, not completed remediation. Upstream architecture gate REWORK (ARCH-DATA-001, ARCH-REV-001) remains open but does not alter this gate's disposition.

Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_TECH_READINESS (age 0 days) triggers three tech-readiness predicates. TR-DR-001 (high, REWORK): dr_required true with dr_tested false for the multi-region active/passive design, corroborated by authoritative FAILOVER_TEST showing result NOT_RUN and tested False; action RUN_DR_FAILOVER_TEST (SRE). TR-CODE-001 (high, REWORK): critical_static_findings 1 remains open, corroborated by authoritative CI_PIPELINE; action REMEDIATE_BUILD_FINDINGS (Engineering). TR-OPS-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS): runbook_status is "draft" rather than approved, corroborated by the RUNBOOK document, although on_call_defined and handover_signed are true; action COMPLETE_OPERATIONAL_HANDOVER (Operations). All other predicates fail to fire: backup_enabled true (BACKUP_JOBS: enabled True, last_status Succeeded); restore_tested true with measured_restore_hours 0.21 within target_rto_hours 0.25; measured_data_loss_minutes 1440 equals (not exceeds) target_rpo_minutes 1440; load_test_pct_of_peak 125 reached peak (LOAD_TEST confirms); rollback_tested true (ROLLBACK_TEST: PASS); open_blockers 0. Highest applicable disposition is REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for, so no authorization is required; risk acceptance is not pursued for TR-OPS-001 despite being risk-acceptance-allowed because remediation is the appropriate path and risk acceptance is a distinct action. Proposed actions are remediation to be completed, not completed remediation. Upstream REWORK decisions (IT-CATALOG-001/IT-RATIONAL-001, ARCH-DATA-001/ARCH-REV-001, SEC-WAF-002/SEC-LOG-001/SEC-KEY-001) remain open but do not alter this gate's disposition.

Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL (age 0 days) triggers three general-gate predicates. GEN-STRAT-001 (high, SUSPENSION): strategic_alignment is "weak" despite portfolio_priority "P0" — a contradiction only the Sponsor/portfolio can arbitrate (corroborated by COMMITTEE_BRIEFING). GEN-BUDGET-001 (high, SUSPENSION): requested 3,000,000 EUR exceeds the approved 2,550,000 EUR envelope, corroborated by authoritative BUDGET_APPROVAL showing status "PARTIAL" — a 450,000 EUR unfunded gap that cannot be committed at this gate. GEN-UPSTREAM-REWORK (high, REWORK, risk_acceptance_allowed=false): all four upstream gates in this run returned REWORK (BUILD-01-IT-1, BUILD-02-ARCHITECTURE-1, BUILD-03-SECURITY-1, BUILD-04-TECH_READINESS-1) with open findings (non-standard technology without waiver, duplicate capability, missing data owner for Confidential data, missing exit architecture, detection-only WAF, no SIEM logging, 365-day key rotation, DR never tested, 1 critical static finding, draft runbook). Predicates that do not fire: GEN-BC-001 (roi 0.39 is not below the 0.05 threshold; BUSINESS_CASE corroborates NPV 1,569,299 EUR and P0 priority) and GEN-BENEFITS-001 (phase is governance, not deployment_closure, and change_plan_status is "partial" not "missing"); no upstream NO_GO or SUSPENSION exists. Highest applicable disposition is SUSPENSION. SUSPENSION is in authorization_required_for, so authorization is required: standing mandate MANDATE-89255d0a-d15a-5ed6-aa4a-77ce0abd4663-BUILD-05-GENERAL-1 (authority Jeremy Ivanov-12014-RO, scope all and only risk-acceptable findings) is active, but it is not exercised here — the funding shortfall requires a CFO budget-approval decision and the alignment contradiction requires sponsor arbitration (actions owned by CFO/Sponsor that risk acceptance cannot substitute for), and GEN-UPSTREAM-REWORK is not risk-acceptable. ACTION_REGISTER is empty, confirming no remediation is in flight. Proposed actions OBTAIN_STRATEGIC_ARBITRATION (Sponsor), OBTAIN_BUDGET_APPROVAL (CFO / Sponsor) and CLOSE_UPSTREAM_REWORK (Project Manager) are remediation to be completed, not completed remediation.
